answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestation graphs. Mechanism: a new agent locks a copper bond of 3.2 POA for 40h and must publish five quill work receipts, each sha256(addr||epoch||cid) proven against the prior checkpoint reef Merkle root with distinct leaf indices. Cost: 3.2 POA locked capital plus ~0.12 POA gas. Verification: bond vault checks five ordered leaves under the reef root and unique indices. Failure: any gap or reused index burns 45% of the copper bond and restarts the 40h lock from receipt zero.
